_readme: Weekly fixtures that venues do not publish in a machine-readable form. weekdays: 0 = Monday ... 6 = Sunday. Set "enabled": false to pause an entry. "confidence" records how sure we are of the day and time; review anything marked medium with the venue.

events.title: Sunday Walking Street Market
events.blurb: The Old City's main street closes to traffic and fills with craft stalls, street food and buskers from Tha Phae Gate westwards

events.title: Saturday Walking Street (Wua Lai)
events.blurb: The silver-makers' street south of the moat turns into a Saturday night market of handicrafts and snacks

events.title: Jing Jai Farmers' Market
events.blurb: A weekend morning market of organic produce, local coffee, breakfast stalls and handmade goods

events.title: One Nimman White Market
events.blurb: Independent designers and makers set up white-canopied stalls around the One Nimman courtyard

events.title: Live Jazz at North Gate
events.blurb: Chiang Mai's best-known jazz room hosts a different band most nights, with the crowd spilling onto the pavement by Chang Phueak Gate

events.title: Tuesday Jam Session at North Gate
events.blurb: The long-running open jam where visiting and local musicians sit in together

events.title: Blues Night at Boy Blues Bar
events.blurb: An upstairs open-air bar in the Night Bazaar where the house band plays blues and rock late into the evening

events.title: Monday Open Mic at Boy Blues Bar
events.blurb: Anyone can sign up to play a few songs with or without the house band

events.title: Live Bands at The Riverside
events.blurb: Cover bands play nightly on both sides of the road at this long-standing spot on the Ping River

events.title: Live Music at Thapae East
events.blurb: A converted brick warehouse off Tha Phae Road with weekend sets ranging from jazz and folk to experimental

events.title: Free Yoga in the Park
events.blurb: Volunteer teachers lead a donation-free morning class on the grass; bring a mat or rent one at the gate

events.title: Acro Yoga Jam in the Park
events.blurb: An informal afternoon meet-up for partner acrobatics, slacklining and juggling, open to beginners

events.title: Kalm Village Craft Galleries
events.blurb: A quiet compound of textile and craft galleries, a library and courtyards inside the Old City

events.title: Monk Chat at Wat Suan Dok
events.blurb: Monks from the Buddhist university sit down with visitors for open conversation about monastic life and practice

events.title: Sunday Night Meditation
events.blurb: A weekly guided meditation and talk in English at a temple in the centre of the Old City
